answer: Assign every identity one saffron-tagged data shard that only it must store, and let independent verifiers send sparrow probes — tiny unpredictable spot-checks demanding a fast proof of custody. Standing climbs toward the summit only after many passed probes across epochs. An attacker must provision separate storage, bandwidth and prompt replies for each shard, so expense grows per fake; clones sharing one shard fail when probes arrive simultaneously at different shards.
